l0.title: Read-only
l0.description: Reads data without changing system state and may run automatically.

l1.title: Low-risk write
l1.description: Creates drafts, comments, or reports and is usually reversible.

l2.title: Medium risk
l2.description: Changes a business resource or workflow and requires at least one approver.

l3.title: High risk
l3.description: May affect production services, data, or permissions and always requires approval.

l4.title: Destructive
l4.description: Irreversible or hard-to-bound impact; disabled by default and requires two approvers.

policy.title: Edit {{name}} policy
policy.description: Configure risk, execution mode, environment overrides, and runtime limits.
policy.hard_floor: Overrides can tighten policy but cannot bypass server-enforced risk floors.
policy.builtin_risk_locked: Built-in tool risk is defined by server code and cannot be lowered here.

defaults.title: Configure tool policy
defaults.description: Set default execution modes by risk and apply stricter environment overrides.
defaults.risk_description: Tool-level policy may override defaults but cannot bypass a hard risk floor.
defaults.environments_description: Set only the risk levels to override; all others inherit defaults.

test.title: Test {{name}}
test.read_description: Fill parameters from the tool Schema; read-only tools may run a real query.
test.write_description: Write-capable tools use Dry Run or validation and never perform a real write.

dependencies.description: Review Agent Profile, automation, and investigation template references before disabling.
dependencies.warning: {{count}} objects currently depend on this tool.

disable.title: Disable {{name}}?
disable.description: Mole Agent will no longer discover or call this tool. Historical records are retained.

mcp.description: Manage constrained MCP connections, credentials, network boundaries, and synchronized tools.

editor.description: Credentials are write-only, encrypted at rest, and never returned by the API or UI.

data.description: Scope comes from the default agent profile; cross-organization access is always forbidden.
data.editor_description: Limit the environments, services, and streams available to the current default profile.

network.title: Network policy
network.description: The current default agent profile controls network access; actual tool capabilities remain constrained by the registry and runtime.
network.editor_description: Choose whether the current default profile may access the network through authorized tools.

network.blocked_explanation: This profile cannot access the network and can use only authorized tools that do not require it.
network.allowed_explanation: This profile may access the network through registered, authorized tools; arbitrary HTTP, shell, browser, and open MCP capabilities are not enabled automatically.
network.capabilities_description: These capabilities come from the tool registry and execution environment and cannot be enabled by the profile switch.

approval_policy.title: Approval policy
approval_policy.description: Risk policies are server-enforced; permissions, resource state, and parameters are revalidated after approval.
approval_policy.editor_description: Configure approval requirements for L0 through L3 operations on the current default profile.
approval_policy.configurable: Automatic by default; profiles may tighten it
